items.description: CIRC: A protocol layer for coordinating clinical agents across systems, specialties, and institutions. A protocol layer for deploying, coordinating, and governing autonomous AI agents in healthcare. CIRC enables clinical agents to route tasks, interoperate across systems (EHRs, claims, labs), and coordinate across specialties.
